In the [From.From.GetName] system sits the scaffold upon which we will build a Dyson Sphere, encompassing [From.From.GetName] and monopolizing the cataclysmic power of the star.

With the frame now in place, the awesome scale of the project is evident to all.

[From.From.GetName] burns in a spindly cage, but will eventually be completely surrounded by [Root.GetAdj] solar panels.

虽然没有完全完成，随着先进的太阳能收集器的安装，我们现在开始收获位于[From.From.GetName]恒星系的戴森球带来的利益。

随着建造继续，能量收入会继续增长，最终戴森球完成时我们将获得完全的运转能力。
texts.en:
While not yet complete, with the installation of advanced solar harvesters we have begun to reap the benefits of the Dyson Sphere being built in the [From.From.GetName] system.

The energy gains will only continue to increase as construction continues, eventually reaching full operational capacity when the Sphere is completed.

[From.From.GetName]星系的主星已被[Root.GetAdj]戴森球完全包裹。

我们的工程师们庆祝着这一胜利，而也理应如此。我们做到了只有少数星系帝国敢于尝试的壮举——完全俘获一颗恒星。
texts.en:
The [From.From.GetName] system's primary has now been completely enveloped by a [Root.GetAdj] Dyson Sphere.

Our engineers celebrate this as a great victory, and rightly so. We have achieved what only a handful of star empires in the history of the galaxy dared imagine - the total subjugation of a star.

label.en: Energy output nominal.

虽然还在早期阶段，完全建造的戴森球将完全阻隔[dyson_system.GetName]的光照，光照将转变为[From.GetAdj]能量储存。
texts.en:
Frenetic activity in the [dyson_system.GetName] system betrays the construction of a Dyson Sphere by the [From.GetName].

Still in its early stages, the completed sphere will eventually blot out the light of [dyson_system.GetName], its radiance diverted to [From.GetAdj] energy stores.

texts.zh: 所有数据显示，又一个星系[dyson_system.GetName]将成为[From.GetName]下一个戴森球的所在地。虽然要花上一段时间，这个巨型结构一旦完成将包裹恒星系的恒星。
texts.en: By all accounts, the [dyson_system.GetName] will soon play host to yet another Dyson Sphere operated by the [From.GetName]. Though it will take some time, the megastructure will completely envelop the system's primary star once completed.

label.en: All stellar powers must eventually tame the stars.
The galaxy darkens.

texts.zh:
我们在[dyson_system.GetName]星系遇到了一个巨型结构的残骸，包围着这个恒星系的恒星。我们的科学家初步判断这曾是个“戴森球”——一个用于彻底利用恒星能量的巨型结构。它显然已经无法继续运转，这是由于它的主体遭受到了来自未知的能量武器的致命打击。

值得注意的是这个戴森球残骸周围同时也漂浮着许多舰船残骸。这个戴森球的本体很古老，但其周围的残骸云明显来自于更近的年代。这些残骸似乎大多来自两支舰队之间的一场激烈交战，这场战斗很可能因为争夺这个废弃戴森球的归属权而爆发。
texts.en:
We have encountered the remains of an enormous space structure in [dyson_system.GetName], encompassing the system's primary. Our scientists theorize that this may have once been a functional "Dyson Sphere" - a megastructure designed to harness the power of a star. It is obviously no longer operational, with its hull having sustained critical damage from an unknown type of energy weapon.

Of note are also the large debris fields surrounding the sphere. Although the megastructure itself is ancient, much of the debris in the system appears to be significantly younger. Most of it seems to originate from two distinct battle fleets that pummeled each other into oblivion, possibly in a war to decide ownership over the shattered sphere at some point in more recent galactic history.

我们成功修复了位于[From.GetName]星系内的废弃戴森球。星系内庞大的碎片云被收集起来用于修复工程，这样既减少了我们资源的消耗，又为工作人员消除了一个潜在的航行风险。

这个巨型结构现已恢复正常运作，在沉寂了千百年后再次产出巨额的能源。

We have successfully repaired the ruined Dyson Sphere in the [From.GetName] system. The large debris fields present in the system were gathered for use in the repair effort, reducing both material costs and removing a potential navigational hazard for the work crews.

The great megastructure is now fully operational, generating vast amounts of energy again for the first time in eons.

summary.text:
# 戴森球 / Dyson Sphere

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/megastructure_events_1.txt、common/megastructures/01_dyson_sphere.txt、common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt（on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded / on_entering_system_first_time）· DLC：Utopia（按本地化文件名）· 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

在你自己的边境内放置并开工戴森球（见 common/megastructures/01_dyson_sphere.txt）。每个建造阶段完工时，巨型结构的 on_build_complete 或 on_megastructure_upgraded 触发对应的国家事件；这些事件只是阶段提示，没有选择分支（每个只有一个“确认”选项）。
You place and start a Dyson Sphere inside your borders (common/megastructures/01_dyson_sphere.txt). Every completed build stage fires a country event for the builder; these are stage notices with a single confirm option, no branching.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. utopia.4000：戴森球基址建成（dyson_sphere_0） / Dyson Sphere site built (dyson_sphere_0)
2. utopia.4003：框架建成（dyson_sphere_1） / Frame built (dyson_sphere_1)
3. utopia.4004：部分建成：已装嵌板（dyson_sphere_2） / Panels installed (dyson_sphere_2)
4. utopia.4005：戴森球完工（dyson_sphere_5） / Dyson Sphere completed (dyson_sphere_5)

按顺序出现，由建造进度决定，不由事件编号决定。 They appear in construction order, driven by build progress rather than by event id.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 其他帝国的通知 Notices to other empires：
- utopia.4002：框架完成时：有通讯并有经济/科技情报的玩家帝国收到通知（隐藏事件4001） / When the frame stage is built: human empires with communications/intel get a notice (hidden 4001)
- 废墟 The ruin：utopia.2010（星系首次进入时，需该星系的星标记“ruined_dyson_system”）可以选择“与我们的相近”（已拥有同类）或“很迷人”（没有同类时，30天后进入通用跟进事件 story.5）；utopia.2011 在修复完成后出现。
  utopia.2010 fires when a ship first enters the system; the option depends on whether you already own this megastructure ("fascinating" otherwise, which fires the generic follow-up story.5 after 30 days). utopia.2011 fires when the ruin is restored.
- 没有随机或互斥分支，只有“建造阶段”与“废墟/修复”两条独立线索。 No random or exclusive branches: two independent threads (build stages; ruin and restoration).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 建造阶段事件仅发给建造国；通知事件发给满足通讯与情报条件的其他非AI国家。 Stage events go to the builder only; notices go to other non-AI countries that meet the communication/intel condition.
- dyson_sphere_3、_4 阶段只发出隐藏的提示消息 utopia.4006，没有可读事件。 Stages dyson_sphere_3 and _4 only fire the hidden alert message utopia.4006; there is no readable event for them.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：common/megastructures/01_dyson_sphere.txt 各阶段 on_build_complete，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt 的 on_megastructure_* 与 on_entering_system_first_time 列表，events/megastructure_events_1.txt 中各事件的 trigger/option。
- 更正 Corrections：原先每个阶段、通知与废墟事件各自成为一个单页故事；现合并为同一巨型结构的故事，阶段按建造顺序连接。 Previously every stage, notice and ruin event was its own one-card story; they are merged and ordered by construction.
- 不确定 Uncertain：废墟如何被放置（星系初始化器/事件的星标记）未逐一追踪。 How ruins are placed on the map (system initializers / star flags) was not traced one by one.
